Ganesan, Advocate, PSPCL Shri Amal Nair, Advocate, PSPCL Ms. Devyani Prasad, Advocate, PSPCL Shri Tushar Mathur, Advocate, HPPC # ** ORDER ** The present Petition has been filed by the Petitioner, JSW Hydro Energy Limited, seeking the following reliefs: _“a) Relax the obligation to declare proportionate overload capacity to the longterm beneficiaries of KWHEP for the period from 15.05.2026 to 15.09.2026, and permit the Petitioner to declare and supply the 10% overload capacity in its entirety, exclusively to the Government of Himachal Pradesh or its nominee; and/or_ _b) pass such further order or orders as this Hon’ble Commission may deem fit and proper in the circumstances of the case.”_ Order in Petition No. 427/MP/2026 Page 2 2. The present Petition was filed on 7.5.2026, and the matter was listed for hearing on 18.9.2026. During the hearing on 18.9.2026, learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the period for which relief was sought in this Petition, i.e., the rainy season from 15.5.2026 to 15.09.2026, had expired, and as such, he prayed that the Petitioner be granted time to either file an amendment application or an application to withdraw the matter, with liberty to file a fresh Petition on the subject matter for the subsequent period. Learned counsel for the Respondent, HPPC, also pointed out that the period for which the reliefs are sought had already expired. Accordingly, the matter was adjourned. 3. Thereafter, the matter was taken up for hearing on 6.11.2026, when the learned counsel for the Petitioner sought permission to withdraw the Petition with liberty to file a fresh Petition on the subject matter for the subsequent period, as the period for which the reliefs sought had already expired and, as such, this Petition had become infructuous. The learned counsel further submitted that, in this regard, the Petitioner has also filed an affidavit dated 23.10.2026. 4. We have considered the parties’ submissions and perused the Petitioner’s affidavit dated 23.10.2026. Considering the Petitioner’s submissions in its affidavit dated 23.10.2026, we allow the Petitioner to withdraw this Petition with liberty to file a fresh Petition on the subject matter for a subsequent period, which will be dealt with in accordance with law. 5. Accordingly, Petition No. 427/MP/2026 is disposed of, as withdrawn. **sd/- sd/- sd/- sd/(Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.) (Jishnu Barua) Member Member Member Chairperson** Order in Petition No. 427/MP/2026 Page 3 CERC Website S. No. 585/2026
